summary: News Corporation filed a routine Form 8-K on September 29, 2026, disclosing daily repurchase activity under its existing $1 billion stock buyback program for Class A and Class B common stock, as required by the Australian Securities Exchange. The filing includes ASX disclosures as exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, with no new price, premium, or transaction terms announced. The board previously authorized the program; no advisor or recommendation is named. The structural note is continued open-market purchases creating a steady demand overhang. Watch for buyback pace as a signal of management's valuation view and potential support for NWSA shares.
